body_lead: CtrlS Datacenters has signed a letter of intent with the Bihar government to invest ₹10,000 crore in a proposed 150 MW hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya, while also inaugurating a ₹400 crore data centre in Patna with an initial IT load capacity of 12 MW. The two projects expand the company’s planned infrastructure footprint in Bihar as demand for artificial intelligence computing, cloud services and data centre capacity continues to grow. The Patna facility is intended to serve enterprises, government institutions, hyperscalers and technology businesses across Bihar and eastern India.
